# API contract instructions

Condensed pointer — full rules: `.claude/rules/api-contract.md`. Day-to-day
guide: `.claude/api-contract-guide.md`.

- The Laravel backend's OpenAPI contract (`openapi/frontend.yaml`) is the
  source of truth for API types. Do not hand-write an interface that
  duplicates a response already covered by a migrated module.
- Never edit `src/types/generated/api.d.ts` — it's generated by
  `npm run contract:generate` (also runs on `postinstall`).
- Only `npm run contract:fetch` may write `openapi/frontend.yaml`.
- Do not migrate Orders, Pallets, Products, or Customers yet.
- Forms (Zod) and ViewModels stay manual — the contract only covers API
  request/response shapes.
